questions.nlq: I would like to know the types of schools in the 2014-2015 academic year for Alameda County.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: In this context, the phrase 'types of schools' refers to the broad classification that tells whether a school is a traditional public school, a charter school, or a private institution.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT CASE 
    WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 'Charter'
    WHEN LOWER("School Type") LIKE '%private%' THEN 'Private'
    ELSE 'Traditional Public'
END AS school_type
FROM frpm
WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND "County Name" = 'Alameda';

meanings.hidden_knowledge: In this context, the phrase 'types of schools' refers to the educational‑option classification such as Traditional, Magnet, or other specialized programs offered by the school.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT "Educational Option Type"
FROM frpm
WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND "County Name" = 'Alameda';

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        "County Name" AS county,
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "County Name" ORDER BY "Free Meal Count (K-12)") AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "County Name") AS cnt
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
),
median_calc AS (
    SELECT
        county,
        CASE
            WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
                MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (cnt + 1) / 2 THEN free_meal END)
            ELSE
                (MAX(CASE WHEN rn = cnt / 2 THEN free_meal END) +
                 MAX(CASE WHEN rn = cnt / 2 + 1 THEN free_meal END)) / 2.0
        END AS median_val
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY county, cnt
)
SELECT
    f."County Name" AS "County Name",
    AVG(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)") AS "Average Free Meal Count"
FROM frpm f
JOIN median_calc m ON f."County Name" = m.county
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > m.median_val
GROUP BY f."County Name";
